description: Tools intentionally registered in packages/mcp-server but NOT in plugins/cfa-core. Each entry declares why the plugin omits the tool — typically because the tool's Rust implementation depends on native crates that don't compile to wasm32-unknown-unknown (rusqlite, ed25519-dalek with random sources, filesystem-bound APIs, etc.).
